parameters.textBody: Got it. We're adding captions and your details now. It will show in your portal for approval in a minute or two.

parameters.query: insert into broker_media (broker_id, kind, language, version, script_text, ai_check, is_current) select b.id, k, $2, coalesce((select max(m.version) from broker_media m where m.broker_id = b.id and m.language = $2),0) + 1, $4, jsonb_build_object('state','processing','take_id',$5), false from brokers b, unnest(case when $3 = 'audio' then array['voice'] else array['video','voice'] end) as k where b.id::text = $1 returning id::text as id, kind, version

nodes.name: Run pipeline.sh (trim, 9:16, captions, lower-third, end-frame, thumbnail, OGG)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL_CHECK, max_tokens: 200, temperature: 0, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'image', source: { type: 'base64', media_type: 'image/jpeg', data: $json.thumb_b64 } }, { type: 'text', text: 'This is a frame from a financial adviser recording a short intro video for a lead. Reply with JSON only: {"face_present":bool,"single_person":bool,"face_centred":bool,"well_lit":bool,"notes":"one plain-English sentence for the adviser, or empty"}. Do not identify anyone.' } ] }] }) }}

parameters.query: update broker_media set url = case when kind = 'video' then $2 else $3 end, thumbnail_url = case when kind = 'video' then nullif($4,'') end, transcript = $5, ai_check = $6::jsonb where id::text = any(string_to_array($1, ',')) returning id::text

parameters.query:
with t as (select id, kind, language, url from broker_media where broker_id::text = $1 and ai_check->>'take_id' = $2 and ai_check->>'state' = 'ready'),
off as (update broker_media m set is_current = false from t where m.broker_id::text = $1 and m.kind = t.kind and m.language = t.language and m.is_current and m.id <> t.id returning m.id),
on_ as (update broker_media m set is_current = true, approved_at = now(), approved_by = 'broker:' || $1 from t where m.id = t.id returning m.id, m.kind, m.language, m.url),
b as (update brokers set intro_video_url = coalesce(intro_video_url, '{}'::jsonb) || coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(language, url) from on_ where kind = 'video'), '{}'::jsonb), intro_voice_url = coalesce(intro_voice_url, '{}'::jsonb) || coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(language, url) from on_ where kind = 'voice'), '{}'::jsonb), onboarding_progress = coalesce(onboarding_progress, '{}'::jsonb) || '{"intro_media":"done"}'::jsonb where id::text = $1 and exists (select 1 from on_) returning id)
select (select count(*) from on_) as approved, (select count(*) from broker_media where broker_id::text = $1 and compliance_checked_by is not null) as spot_checked
